ns2:course.label: Professional Development Seminar
ns2:course.description: Discussion and activities related to professional development and networking for career success. Students will attend professional development activities such as lectures, conferences and networking events. The class meetings will be an opportunity for peer learning through activities, as well as to reflect on professional development activities. The final project is a professional portfolio that is representative of your major work over the course of your academic career. 1 undergraduate hour. No graduate credit. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: Senior standing required.
